description: Enhance the private connections settings page to display the assigned IP addresses for provisioned private links. This will provide administrators with immediate visibility into the specific IPs allocated to their private connections without needing to check external documentation or support channels.
functional_requirements: Display assigned IP addresses alongside provisioned private links in the organization settings interface
Ensure IP information is only shown for private links that are in a 'provisioned' or active state
Maintain the existing layout and styling of the private connections page while adding the new IP information
Handle cases where IP information might not be available (show appropriate placeholder or empty state)
Update any necessary API calls or data fetching to retrieve IP assignment data for private links
